description: ACCDB: DAO Recordset Field.Value assignment conversions on TC(ID PK, B BYTE, I SMALLINT, L LONG, S SINGLE, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, DT DATETIME, Y YESNO, DC DECIMAL(18,4), T TEXT(40), M MEMO, G GUID): Step 1 valid text-to-scalar/date/currency/boolean/decimal & half-to-even rounding; Step 2 numeric/date/bool/currency-to-Text/Memo; Step 3 Null into Yes/No, Empty into all column types, Missing into Long/Text; Step 4 bad text ('abc', '') & overflows into Byte/Integer/Long/Single/Double/Currency/DateTime/YesNo/Decimal/GUID + non-BSTR into GUID.
